degree_rationale: The time when light came and was crucified in the dark — the molding/clothing of First Man, his entry, the storehouses of death, the body's storehouses likened to it. Treats how the mingling-mechanism received cosmic substance.
direction_rationale: Inward processing of how light entered death — the storehouses of the body as receptacles, the soul going out leaving inactive dwellings. Reflective comparison.
grand_man_function: Spiritual storehouse-reception — the inward holding of soul and substance.
title: The appointed time when the light came and was crucified in the dark
